correctness.rationale: Exact support-function decomposition \(W=\sqrt{1-T^2}w_K(V)+hT\) with spherical \(T\) uniform on \([0,1]\) yields both moments by five definite integrals. The normalized second-moment ratio has derivative \(32[((\pi-2)\lambda+\pi-4q)]/[3(\pi+2\lambda)^3]\) and has exactly one positive zero because \(q\ge1\). The optimized ratio increases strictly with \(q\), whose minimum 1 occurs iff continuous planar width is constant. Independent common-denominator reduction gives the two nonnegative terms in the exact shape–height deficit identity; all denominators are positive. Akiyama–Kamae Theorems 6–7 supply the explicitly cited n-gon equality classification for n not power of two. Package verifier executed successfully, 16,020 check comparisons including directional quadrature; finite checks supplement exact proof.

value.rationale: A natural complete extremal problem across arbitrary 3D Euclidean right prisms has an explicit universal optimum, nontrivial continuum of exact equality shapes including noncircular constant-width bases, and a sharp decomposition of the quantitative deficit into two positive terms corresponding separately to base shape and prism height. For every polygonal side count not a power of two the result yields precise aspect ratios and the complete Reinhardt equality family by a credited planar theorem. This provides geometric information not supplied by the known fixed-height mean-square moment; it is not a mere renaming or arbitrary finite example.
